description: This Java interface defines various methods for reading product-to-GL account mappings for different financial products in the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for fetching account mappings related to loans, savings, and share products, as well as charge-off and write-off reasons.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping details for a specified loan product and accounting type.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches payment type to fund source mappings for a given loan product.

methods.name: fetchFeeToGLAccountMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves fee to GL account mappings for loans.

methods.name: fetchPenaltyToIncomeAccountMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves penalty to income account mappings for loans.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping details for a savings product.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Fetches payment type to fund source mappings for savings products.

methods.name: fetchFeeToIncomeAccountMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves fee to income account mappings for savings products.

methods.name: fetchPenaltyToIncomeAccountMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves penalty to income account mappings for savings products.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForShareProduct
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping details for a share product.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappingsForShareProduct
methods.description: Fetches payment type to fund source mappings for share products.

methods.name: fetchFeeToIncomeAccountMappingsForShareProduct
methods.description: Retrieves fee to income account mappings for share products.

methods.name: fetchChargeOffReasonMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches charge-off reason mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchWriteOffReasonMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches write-off reason mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchClassificationMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves classification mappings for a loan product based on specified classification parameter.
